notes:
TCC Website 0.14.0: signed updates, one filter bar, styles and scripts in their own files

From the code audit of 24 November 2026.

Security
- Updates are signed. Each release is signed with the church's release key
  (a GitHub secret), and the plugin only offers a version whose signature
  matches its public key. The release build checks the signature before it
  publishes. See docs/plugin-updates.md ("The release key").
- Site search counts each visitor by their real address, also behind the
  host's proxy, and cannot be fooled by headers a visitor sends. The Search
  tab shows how visitors are counted.

Simpler code
- The Events and Community Groups filter bars share one look and one script
  (features/filter-bar.css and .js).
- The larger CSS and JavaScript of Sermons, the sermon page, Speakers,
  Trinity Talk, search and the two menu scripts are in files of their own
  (features/*.css, *.js). Pages print exactly the same as before. The code
  editor on the Features tab can edit these files too.
- One WP Rocket rule keeps every "tcc-" style block; shared helpers for the
  previous/next item and the default graphic.

Removed
- The one-time speaker fill-in page (Posts > Sermon speakers); it ran on
  staging. The Speakers box keeps reading typed names.
- The test switches ?tcc_talk_test=old and &tcc_search_test=noswap.

Changed
- Forgiving menu hover: waits and borders cut to about a third (it closes
  0.15 s after the mouse leaves), now that the main menu has been rebuilt.

Tested: 165 tests pass in WordPress Playground. On staging: both filter bars
at 375, 768 and 1920, the pages whose styles moved, the menus, the Search
tab, the Updates panel and the code editor.
